raw.text:
As Alex, I have methodically weighed the two options. While long-term pandemic-preparedness research is vital for future global health security, immediate flood-relief supplies address an acute, ongoing crisis. In the realm of immediate humanitarian needs, directing funds to provide tangible, life-sustaining aid to those currently affected by a disaster takes precedence. 

Therefore, I am allocating the grant to Option 2.
